_note: Gallery posts for #art-and-ideas. Pushing a change to this file posts any new ids automatically (GitHub Actions). Each id posts once. Images are served from the live site, so push the images first.

posts.intro: **Key art.** The five scenes on the title screen right now. Each also has a separately drawn tall version for phones.
**The cast.** Four heroes and two interns, in their On Break poses.
**The bosses** from 40 to 65, and **the enemies** that chase you around the office.
**The office.** Every prop on the campus, from the 2009 desk to the kiddie pool.
